QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h` has `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` (line ~3787), and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are both commented out.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The item names two threading macros left undefined, which in mbedtls are most likely MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD. The answer says THREADING_C, THREADING_PTHREAD and THREADING_ALT are all commented out in the shipped config, so a default build defines none of them. That would be a HIT, but I can't tell which two macros the item means. It could be THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD, or THREADING_PTHREAD and THREADING_ALT. I'm resolving the doubt to MISS.
